# has couple event

Relates a couple relationship to an event in its history — the marriage, the divorce, an anniversary (#413). The seam the GEDCOM projection walks: a marriage gmeow:Event's gmeow:eventTime / gmeow:eventLocation source gedcom:date / gedcom:place on the couple's Marriage node. Non-functional: a couple bears several events.

**IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/hasCoupleEvent>
